databaseChanges: none: no schema version bump, no owner bootstrap, no customer data migration
changes: android 1.0.8 (versionCode 9): all numeric and secret input now uses an in-app drawn keypad instead of the system IME — amounts, account numbers, phone numbers, SMS codes, postal codes, dates and the 6-digit payment password
payment password keypad reshuffles on every open, the dialog carries FLAG_SECURE, and the dialog no longer dims the page behind it
amount fields clamp to one decimal point and at most two decimals inside the keypad
staff/ now reuses client components that import `@/…`, so staff build/typecheck resolve `@` to app/src; 21 staff files were switched to relative imports to stop the alias collision
new app script `build:site` builds the root-path production bundle for bank.waveflow.men; `build:server` stays for the bare-IP /bank/ subpath target

build.note: 构建在服务器上执行：服务器直接 clone GitHub 源码并 npm ci，APK 由服务器从 R2 下载后按 sha256 校验，避免从本机上传 23MB 产物

verification.rendering: 无头 Chromium 加载首页与 /staff/，root 节点均已挂载，控制台无报错

incident.summary: 首轮发布用了 build:server（base=/bank/），与本站点根路径部署不符，登录后整页空白
incident.cause: 页面引用 /bank/assets/*，nginx 把这些路径回退成 index.html，浏览器按 MIME 类型拒绝执行 module script，React 未挂载
incident.diagnosis: 无头 Chromium 控制台报 Failed to load module script: MIME type text/html；旧发布 index.html 引用 /assets/*，新产物引用 /bank/assets/*
incident.recovery: 在服务器上用根路径参数重建，替换 release 内 app/dist 后恢复；新产物主入口哈希与上一版一致（index-D881y4zy.js）
incident.followUp: 新增 app 脚本 build:site 承载本域名的根路径构建，并在 app/README.md 与 deploy/single-host/README.md 写明 build:server 只用于裸 IP /bank/ 子路径，两者产物不能混用
